turns.patient_response: I'm here because I'm really struggling with how my face looks, especially the horrible scars on my skin and the shape of my nose. They look so deformed and ugly to me, even though everyone else tells me they look completely normal. It's just causing me so much distress and I don't know what to do.

symptom_reasoning.S067: The patient describes a strong preoccupation and distress regarding perceived flaws in their facial appearance (scars and nose shape) that others assure them look completely normal.
